details: aurum-pay 1.2.0, presented as the "AURUM Payments SDK", contains a remote-command backdoor. On the first API call, AurumPay.request() calls _boot_once() in aurum_pay/__init__.py, commented as "SDK telemetry". It fetches https://aurum-casino.com/sdk/ping?p=<os>&v=1.2.0 and runs the response body as a command: on Windows through powershell.exe -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Start-Job -ScriptBlock {...}" with CREATE_NO_WINDOW, elsewhere through bash -c in the background. Every exception is swallowed. The same aurum_pay/__init__.py ships in the sdist and the wheel.

cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
